name: notifications
//: The application-wide toast layer. Presentation lives in the design system (`mm-toast-region`); this package is the wiring — it subscribes to NOTIFICATION_SHOW on the event bus and turns each payload into a toast. Split out of `nav` deliberately: the chrome is suppressed on /login and /register while a failed-login toast must still appear, so the two have different route contracts, different consumers and different reasons to change.
//framework: No framework and no `single-spa`. A toast region has no routes, no forms and no queries — it is one element reacting to one event stream — and it is mounted on every route, so any runtime it pulled in would be paid for on first paint by every visitor. The single-spa adapter is `src/lifecycles.ts`.
